props.text: Tooltip: a short label or an icon in a bubble with an arrow, in one of seven variants.
Toggletip: a title, description and optional text content and two actions in a bubble.

config.script:
# GF-37: a component event runs this script on the gateway; its payload is the object `event`
	stamp = system.date.format(system.date.now(), 'HH:mm:ss')
	try:
		body = system.util.jsonEncode(event)
	except:
		body = unicode(event)
	line = stamp + '  onPrimaryAction  ' + body[:150]
	old = self.view.custom.log_toggletip
	rows = [line] + ([r for r in old.split(chr(10)) if r] if old and not old.startswith('No event') else [])
	self.view.custom.log_toggletip = chr(10).join(rows[:6])
